q1_issues.issue: "a Medicare drug package" fuses a proper-noun premodifier into the compound `medicare_drug_package`, which Names and casing bars — the head phrase should be typed on its own and linked to the named entity by the opaque `Possession`.
No `(Name medicare "Medicare")` atom is emitted for the proper noun the text mentions, and a proper noun's `Name` fact is not optional.

notes: "by August" is dropped with no trace; the superseded-bound rule does sanction emitting only the operative Oct-17 bound, but it also lets the superseded bound survive `Past`-wrapped as history, which this text arguably states. Whether the capitalized plural "Republicans" should instead be the `Name`-only plural-label individual of Names and casing rather than `(GroupOf … republican)` is a genuine boundary case; the control-verb complement, the past-perfect `Before`, and the occurrence-object `Patient` on "extended" are all correct.
